title: Production Manufacturing
author: 645ed7a98664cb37fb18ff9b
chapter_outcomes: consider how existing products meet the needs of the users
consider production manufacturing as: one-off, batch and mass production

generate design proposals: identify the resources needed, plan the stages of manufacture, evaluate proposals against a specification, understand the relevance of function and aesthetics (in terms of the appreciation of the use of line, shape, form, proportion, space, colour and texture) as appropriate to their designed solutions and the work of others, understand the importance of anthropometrics and ergonomics, use modelling to test proposals
